name: AI
tagline: AI manifest aggregation module for VirtoCommerce Platform. Collects and exposes AI tool and agent definitions from all installed modules.

git.lastCommit: cc3c1b0 2026-07-14 Merge pull request #7 from VirtoCommerce/VCST-5373

readme.overview: The VirtoCommerce.AI module provides: - A centralized endpoint (`/api/ai/manifest`) that aggregates AI capabilities from all installed modules. This enables external AI backends (like the Python-based virto-oz-backend) to discover and use tools and agents defined across your VirtoCommerce installation. - An **AI Assistant blade** in the platform admin that embeds an external chatbot SPA via `<iframe>`. The chatbot URL is configured through `appsettings.json` and exposed to the admin UI through a typed options endpoint.
keyFeatures: **Automatic Discovery**: Scans all installed modules for AI definitions
**Tool Definitions**: Aggregates YAML-based tool definitions from `ai/tools/` directories
**Agent Definitions**: Aggregates Markdown-based agent definitions from `ai/agents/` directories
**ETag Caching**: Supports HTTP ETag headers for efficient bandwidth usage
**Cache Invalidation**: API endpoint to force manifest regeneration
**Permission-Based Access**: All endpoints protected by VirtoCommerce RBAC
**AI Assistant blade**: Embeds an external chatbot SPA into the admin UI via iframe (configurable through `appsettings.json`)
